# MAX-11 — Maximiser Processing Load still defaults ON after SUI-21

**Tracking issue:** https://github.com/tonygward/audio-plugins/issues/297
**Origin:** Generated by Matrix from the tracking issue when the card was picked up, because no prompt file existed and the issue had enough detail. The issue text below is the specification.

## Objective and user value
Correct a user-reported defect: **Songsmith Maximiser still opens with Processing Load ON**, despite the suite-wide default-OFF implementation in SUI-21 (#291) delivered in v0.5.32. Users should see the clean plugin UI by default.

## Existing behaviour
- User reports Maximiser Processing Load is still enabled by default after the SUI-21 delivery.
- #291 / PR #292 merged and beta v0.5.32 published, but its completion comments explicitly say **not verified in a DAW**.
- Do not assume whether this is an editor initialisation bug, a persisted preference, a preset/migration issue, or an old installer still being loaded; investigate and identify the cause.

## Desired behaviour
- Fresh Maximiser instance with **no stored preference**: Processing Load OFF, CPU and latency diagnostics hidden.
- Default settings / reset: OFF unless the user explicitly selected ON and persistence is intentionally supported.
- Manual ON/OFF toggling works; accurately shows diagnostics when enabled.
- Previously saved sessions and presets continue to load correctly; do not silently overwrite deliberate user preferences.
- Verify the same requirement in other suite plugins without duplicating their code or regressing defaults.

## Implementation guidance
1. Reproduce in an actual host or representative plugin-host smoke test, using a **clean settings/profile** and a fresh Maximiser VST3 instance.
2. Check the initialised editor flag, saved XML/diagnostic preferences, default state, reset/preset handling, and editor reopen/instance recreation; distinguish code default from locally persisted ON.
3. Check whether an older plugin build is being loaded in preference to v0.5.32; report the actual loaded version/build when reproducing.
4. Fix the root cause using shared defaults where appropriate; do not hard-code an isolated visual workaround. Avoid changes to DSP, latency measurement, preset audio parameters or performance.

## Acceptance criteria and tests
- [ ] Reproduce and document the reported Maximiser behaviour and root cause, or record why reproduction could not be achieved.
- [ ] Clean install/settings, new Maximiser instance: Processing Load OFF, diagnostics hidden.
- [ ] Closing/reopening editor and creating a second instance do not unexpectedly turn the display ON.
- [ ] Reset, factory preset selection, project reload and legacy preference migration behave consistently, preserving deliberate ON only when explicitly supported.
- [ ] Manual ON/OFF toggle works and CPU/latency data displays correctly when ON.
- [ ] Automated regression coverage includes Maximiser clean initialisation and persisted-preference cases; relevant GUI/build checks pass.
- [ ] Verify against a real host/DAW where practical; include test environment, loaded plugin version and evidence in issue comments.

## Dependencies and risks
- Regression follow-up to **SUI-21 #291**, implementation **PR #292**, beta release **v0.5.32**.
- A previously saved ON preference or stale plugin binary may explain the observation; establish which before changing defaults.
- Preserve existing sessions and compatibility.

## Build and release
Use repository version/build policy, CI, PR/merge and Cloudflare R2/beta website delivery. Comment issue with pickup, root cause, tests, build and release evidence. Close/mark Done only after publishing the corrected installer and verifying delivery.

**Backlog only — not yet queued or claimed by Matrix.**
